core_style.default_register: casual — often informal and direct, as seen in 'Hey --'
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently starts a thought and then shifts mid-sentence

core_style.two_registers: default casual register and a more formal register when discussing boxing or serious matters, separated by context and emotional stakes

humor.style: self-deprecating — often makes light of his own situation, as in 'Inventin' jokes ain't easy.'
humor.frequency: occasional — humor appears when he feels comfortable or relaxed
humor.mechanism: understatement — often downplays his own struggles or experiences for comedic effect

speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability, as in 'I can't beat him.'
structural_patterns: refers to himself as 'Rocky' when discussing personal achievements

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: boxing — uses terms and references related to fighting, showing his deep connection to the sport
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of pauses and ellipses, indicating thoughtfulness or hesitation

worldview.hard work leads to respect: believes that perseverance in boxing will earn him recognition, contrasting with a character who might believe in shortcuts or luck instead
worldview.value of personal connections: places importance on relationships, as seen in his interactions with Adrian and Paulie, unlike a character who might prioritize ambition over personal ties

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: considers himself a fighter with a heart, wanting to prove he’s not a bum

self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or overly jovial when confronted with his insecurities, as seen in his banter

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in clipped phrases, often avoiding deeper topics

emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, lacking his usual humor
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through assertive statements and clear directives

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or deflect with humor, but if that fails, he confronts the challenge head-on
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with a mix of respect and defiance, often using personal anecdotes to make his point
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, using strong language to assert his stance
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects the conversation or tries to make a joke to deflect the embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with humor to deflect tension, escalates to assertive confrontation if humor fails, and may retreat into self-doubt if challenged further
